scope: Content fitting across the original and modern LING285 studio, both modules, collections and readers.
preservation: Existing course payloads, source assets, transcript editions, question IDs and saved responses remain unchanged.
fixes: Natural-height source galleries keep every slide and caption in document flow.
Card and reader bodies own consistent inner spacing; nested pairs do not cancel it.
Text and media reflow according to the available reading width while preserving normal type size and source proportions.
Playback controls occupy a separate row below each video instead of covering its content.
Existing notes, read marks and source controls use a full-width footer.
Long code, tables and selected option descriptions fit without hiding their contents.

otherChecks: Every numbered collection at desktop/mobile widths
Actual source-media aspect ratios after loading
Current 100-question test, eight lecture quizzes, writing drafts and backup workflow
